chunks: When We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying]: 'Do not associate anything with Me, and purify My House for those who circumambulate it, stand in prayer, and bow in prostration.'
ai.seo_question: What did God command Abraham regarding the Kaaba and ritual purity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the Kaaba as the primordial center of monotheistic worship, originally built by Abraham and his son Ishmael, and later purified from idolatry. The command to 'purify My House' is often interpreted by scholars as a directive for both physical cleanliness and spiritual devotion, linking the physical act of Tawaf to the inner state of the pilgrim. It underscores the continuity of the prophetic mission, connecting Abraham's foundational role to the ritual practices observed by Muslims today.
